summary: NVIDIA selected Unitree as the hardware foundation of its first open humanoid reference design (Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot, announced GTC Taipei 2026-05-31): Unitree H2 Plus chassis + Jetson AGX Thor compute, sold via Unitree in late 2026; the GR00T developer platform also supports the Unitree G1.

Meituan is Unitree's largest external institutional shareholder: three concert-party entities (Hanhai Information 7.61%, Galaxy Z, Chengdu Longzhu) hold 9.6488% combined pre-IPO (Hanhai is the third-largest shareholder overall), entered from the 2024-09 B+ round.
Tencent (via Tencent Technology) invested in Unitree's 2025-06 C round with RMB 80.0008M, holding 2.17917M shares pre-IPO per the prospectus (~0.54% post-issue).

Alibaba invested in Unitree's 2025-06 C round: wholly-owned subsidiary Hangzhou Haoyue holds 1.634346M shares pre-IPO; affiliate Ant Group (via Shanghai Yunchang) holds 0.817236M shares (~0.61% combined post-issue).

UBTech and Unitree are direct competitors in China's humanoid robot market: industry comparisons place them in the top tier (Unitree ~18,000 cumulative bipedal humanoids vs UBTech ~3,000 by 2026-08) with diverging strategies — Unitree on cost/volume, UBTech on industrial deployments (Walker S in BYD/Geely lines).
